subject: group chat people
caption: Send this to the friend who is all four. They know who they are.

beats.text: Every group chat has these four people. You are at least two.
Reads every message. Replies in the next financial year.
No words. Just a frog holding a knife.
Trying to arrange a meet-up since March.
You are at least two of these. You know which.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
